title: Language acquisition
learning_outcomes: Explain functional goals in the context of language acquisition.
Compare and distinguish input and retrieval in the context of language acquisition.
Apply corrective feedback in the context of language acquisition.
Evaluate and justify decisions about contextual exchange in the context of language acquisition.

lessons.title: Functional goals
lessons.outcome: Explain functional goals in the context of language acquisition.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving functional goals; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to language conversation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain functional goals from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of functional goals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Input and retrieval
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish input and retrieval in the context of language acquisition.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving input and retrieval; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to language conversation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain input and retrieval from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of input and retrieval; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Corrective feedback
lessons.outcome: Apply corrective feedback in the context of language acquisition.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving corrective feedback; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to language conversation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain corrective feedback from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of corrective feedback; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Contextual exchange
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about contextual exchange in the context of language acquisition.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving contextual exchange; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to language conversation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain contextual exchange from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of contextual exchange; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of functional goals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of input and retrieval; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of corrective feedback; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of contextual exchange; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Communication instructor; language instructor as needed.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
